text: S508 closes as a bounded practical Standard DXF diagnosis. Correct 100%/centimeter reimport and re-export complete without an error dialog, but the second-generation file reimports as a narrow stack of overlapping outlines. It contains 36 pattern-block inserts and 141 LWPOLYLINE records versus 9 inserts and 59 polylines in generation one; exact source contour matching yields 0/18 at 0.001 cm. The earlier 1000% reimport was a unit-confounded exploratory run and is excluded. Reject only this tested Standard path for this fixture/settings; preserve all V03 and all-seven gates.
